cases.title: A placed pit's number label lands on the point clicked, within 1 mm, reads P8 on STORMWATER PIT LABEL, the cover text reads CL 19.000, and one U removes all three
cases.plan_item: UX-CPLAN-21 pit label and cover level (daily card D09, the whole card)
cases.expected: Running snaps off. PIT at 150000,-80000 with cover level 19.000; the label point clicked at 150000,-78500 in a 100 mm high view and the cover text point clicked at 150000,-78530: exactly one new pit block on STORMWATER PIT, one new PIT LABEL block on STORMWATER PIT LABEL whose PIT_LABEL reads P8 and whose insertion point is within 1 mm of 150000,-78500, and one new text reading exactly CL 19.000 (no IL line); the command line says 'Pit placed successfully.'; one U echoes PIT and leaves no new object behind.
cases.why_not_unit: The label block, its attribute and the cover MText are created by the live PIT prompts in the real drawing.
not_automated: The card answers the label prompt with a typed point; the robot cannot type while CE waits at that prompt, so a mouse click at high zoom stands in for it.
The cover text's corner and the look of the label and cover text are a picture item (the card does not ask for them).

cases.why_not_unit: It exists only to prove N25's 1 mm position check can go red at a few millimetres.
